name: Azure Functions
sku: Azure Functions on its Flex Consumption, Premium, Dedicated and Container Apps hosting options, with Durable Functions for workflows.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Triggers and bindings connect functions to other services with no extra code: run code when a file is uploaded to blob storage, when a message arrives on a queue, Service Bus or Event Hubs, or when a database document changes.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Timer-driven functions run tasks such as data clean-up code on predefined intervals.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: The Durable Functions extension builds an event-driven workflow from a series of functions. It is code-first and application-oriented rather than a data-pipeline DAG.

transform.code-transform.note: Captures and transforms data from event and IoT streams on the way to storage, in C#, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, Python or Go. It suits light per-event transformation, not large-scale batch processing.

presentation.tagline: Serverless code that runs on events, timers and HTTP requests.
